sections.brief: South Lebanon 2024-26: from five positions to the Forward Defense Line / Yellow Line (19 Apr 2026 map, 5-10 km, ~6% of Lebanon by NPR), Beaufort; Israel's stated rationale (IDF, Netanyahu, Sa'ar 'no territorial ambitions') beside Lebanon's, Hezbollah's and the UN's (1701, UNIFIL counts, resolution 2790 and the 31 Dec 2026 end); Tampa talks; the 1985-2000 precedent; status as of October 2026. Syria after Assad: 8 Dec 2024 'collapsed' declaration, buffer zone and Hermon, 'temporarily' to 'indefinite', the Feb 2025 demilitarisation demand, the 15 km/60 km description, Golan population plan; Sufa 53 (begun 2022, resumed 4 Oct 2026) and Arab/UAE condemnations; UN and Syrian positions; talks; status as of October 2026. Figures: compare; time

Gaza: pre-war 17% buffer (OCHA 2010); the Trump plan's line and 'will not occupy or annex'; the Yellow Line share over time (53% Oct 2025; 58% Dec 2025/Jan 2026; orange line and 64% Apr 2026; Netanyahu 60% and directive to 70% May 2026; Israel's ~70% to the UN June 2026; OCHA 65% Oct 2026), each with source and date; Zamir 'new border line', COGAT, Hamas and UN positions; then what the three zones show and do not show.
